description: Erection of a first floor side extension with one front and one rear roof window to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-B-00001 P1, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-B-00002 P2, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-B-00100 P2, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-B-00101 P2, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-B-00200 P2 and 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-B-00300 P2. Received on 25/05/2022; 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-A-00002 P4, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-A-00100 P6, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-A-00101 P6, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-A-00102 P3, 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-A-00200 P6 and 2230-NMA-00-ZZ-DR-A-00300 P4. Received on 15/11/2022].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.
